experiments.Name: Checklist catches broken toggles
experiments.Hypothesis: A short verification checklist will catch empty toggles, broken links and missing views before a template is marked ready.
experiments.Learnings: The checklist caught two empty toggles and a board with no grouping in the first trial. It now runs before any template leaves the lab.

experiments.Name: Cover set speeds first setup
experiments.Hypothesis: A small library of mist and landscape covers will cut first-page setup time compared with searching from scratch.
experiments.Learnings: Test begins once the first set of twelve covers is selected.

experiments.Name: Briefing in five minutes
experiments.Hypothesis: A one-screen morning briefing can be read in under five minutes and still leave a clear first action.
experiments.Learnings: Early drafts were too long. The next pass keeps only three signals and one recommended action.

experiments.Name: Quiet hours demand test
experiments.Hypothesis: People will use a quiet-hours toggle on deep-work pages at least twice a week if it is one click away.
experiments.Learnings: Usage was too low to judge. The idea is parked until there is a clearer moment to test again.
